understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate through every level, modify the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation as needed, and step onto each goal cell only when all three attributes matched the goal's requirements. Completing every goal in a level advances to the next level, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls block movement, so the blocked_directions list must be checked before every action and blocked directions must never be attempted. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle colors orange → blue → green → red → orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Modifier effects occur when stepping onto their tiles, while goals activate only when shape, color, and rotation all match. The episode demonstrated that inefficient back-and-forth movement and ignoring route planning can waste stamina and lives.
